# 1 Enoch Chapter 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** Look up at the heavens. Watch how everything up there keeps its course — the stars never break out of their orbits. Every light in the sky rises and sets in perfect order, season after season, never straying from its appointed path.

**2** Now look at the earth. Study everything that happens on it, from start to finish. See how stable it all is — nothing in creation departs from its nature. Everywhere you look, the works of God are on display.

**3** Watch the seasons turn from summer to winter: the whole earth is drenched with water — clouds roll in, dew settles, rain falls.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of the brief opening meditation. The repeated imperatives ("look," "watch," "study") render the Ge'ez re'iku with the urgency of a teacher directing pupils' attention. The three observations (heavens, earth, seasons) build the argument that will culminate in the contrast with sinful humanity in ch. 5.*
